title: Graphics: sokol_gfx.h initialization (pipeline, render pass)
acceptance_criteria: sg_setup() initializes sokol_gfx with backend auto-detection
Render pass descriptor configured with default framebuffer
Graphics pipeline created with vertex/fragment shaders for 2D rendering

Clear color set (dark background for file manager theme)
sg_commit() called at end of each frame
